<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C13H10O), DBE (9), aromatic carbons (12) and a single carbonyl group, the compound is most consistent with benzophenone (diphenyl ketone). The possible fragments that can be recombined to form this molecule are a phenyl ring and a benzoyl fragment. Their SMILES strings are “c1ccccc1” (phenyl) and “O=Cc1ccccc1” (benzoyl).</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccccc1', 'O=Cc1ccccc1']</final_answer>
